description: Fails closed against a reachable base and transitively discovers widget subclasses across production roots. New or moved public widgets require Widgetbook coverage; shared widgets also require a canonical Catch* name and exact registry source identity. The generated markdown inventory is not an input. Private widgets and Widget-returning helpers remain blocked, except those a recorded Phase 4 screen move (tool/architecture/screen_moves/) carried unchanged in name; generated exclusions are file-specific or suffix-specific.

rules.title: Keep widget catalog rules and usage decisions current when widget architecture changes
rules.instruction: The widget inventory is derived from production Widget declarations and design/components/catch.components.json and never committed; node tool/design/generate_widget_catalog.mjs --write writes it to build/generated/widget_catalog.md. docs/widget_catalog.md holds only the authored Canonical Usage Decisions. Every new or moved public widget in shared, Consumer, or Host production source needs exact-name Widgetbook coverage. Shared Widgets require a canonical Catch* name and an exact source identity, reviewed ladder level and role in the registry; new or moved feature UI requires its feature-prefixed role name and canonical file suffix. The complete shared API must satisfy the naming grammar. Existing feature naming candidates remain source-derived review flags, not approved exceptions or a conformance claim. New or moved private widget classes and Widget-returning functions/getters are prohibited. Exact duplicate public widget class names and normalized public-name collisions fail unless every colliding symbol is an explicitly governed concept/member family. Update the usage decisions and registry in the same pass when adding, deleting, moving, renaming, or materially changing a widget, primitive API, screen ownership model, sliver/tab structure, or reusable design-system role. Do not append release notes or per-change changelog headings.
